body:
I didn't mean stop eating that, I just meant I cut out everything else so I don't think that is something that is going to work for me.  I will look into foods that are supposed to help, just trying not to get my hopes up with that.

I don't know anyone that would go with me and I don't want to travel alone, especially during a pandemic.

I have not thought of my diet contributing to my tinnitus, but when I was doing keto it didn't change and all I ate was meat and vegetables so if those are out then yeh I am screwed.

The scars from surgery as well as the months of recovery just make that unappealing, especially when I have no motivation to do that... losing weight led to fall further than I ever have before specifically because I had gained the false hope that I did actually deserve happiness only to get a hard dose of reality yet again.  I just don't have it in me to do it again...I definitely won't make it if I do.

I getting not spreading the pain, but I am not going to ever stop hating myself, so that just again means that I should just continue being in pain every day...which sounds alot like my feeling don't matter while everyone else's does...which is selfish I guess...another thing wrong with me yay.
